entries.note: PMID 18260618, epub 2008-02-09; quote verbatim in abstract. FDA 202293 PharmR confirms the STZ rat as the filed insulin-deficient model (0.03 and 0.1 mg/kg). Track opener; nothing to change.

PMID 23011728, epub 2012-09-25; quote verbatim (abstract). Han 2008 model-side quote verbatim. CT.gov intervention search: only two T2D remogliflozin records, no T1D entry, so registry_date null stands. Proximal readout, direction only: same holds.

Cherney PMID 24334175 epub 2013-12-13; Vallon PMID 24226524 epub 2013-11-13; quotes verbatim (abstracts). NCT01392560 results 2014-06-17, GFR primary. Model epub only 30 days before trial epub (trial ended 2012-08): rule question. Vallon 2013 Sglt2-KO Akita is an earlier first use.

PMID 25271207, epub 2014-09-30, print 2015-03; quote verbatim (abstract). NCT01498185 results 2017-02-10, primary 7-point glucose day 7. EASE-1 (NCT01969747, results 2015-04-08) later adds empagliflozin UGE; no change.

Quote verbatim; FDA 202293 PharmR confirms STZ-rat mg/kg response, no exposure or margin stated. EMA WS/1344 kept only 5 mg dapagliflozin on DKA, no model margin, so once-in-safety fits decision 16. Rule question: untested vs same.

Quote verbatim. Luippold 2012 (PMID 22268612, epub 2012-02-23) abstract carries both judgement quotes verbatim: low-dose insulin plus empagliflozin matched high-dose insulin; adjunctive-to-insulin T1DM potential. Same system, one track: agreed.

PMID 28919061, epub 2017-09-14; quote verbatim (abstract). NCT02268214 results 2018-03-29, HbA1c primary. EASE-1 primary was day-7 UGE, Henry 2015 7-point glucose, Perkins GFR: 2017 dating holds. NCT02460978 2018-11-06 and NCT02897219 (no results) confirmed.

PMID 30287422, epub 2018-10-04; quote verbatim (abstract). NCT02580591 results 2018-11-02, NCT02414958 2018-11-20, HbA1c week-26 primary on both. Kaku 2019 quote verbatim (PMID 31173455, epub 2019-07-11). Strengthening entry agreed.

Quote verbatim. My grep of 202293 PharmR: zero ketone/ketosis/ketoacidosis/hydroxybutyrate/acidosis hits, four STZ hits, confirming silence. Empagliflozin 206111 PharmR line 557: 'ketone bodies were unremarkable (data not shown)', a stated negative that strengthens the later contra. Luippold full text unverified.

Quote verbatim (abstract). Peters 2015 full text: dapagliflozin/empagliflozin only in reference titles, confirmed. EASE-1 and Henry 2015 report no DKA; DEPICT-1 24-wk 1%/2%/1% verbatim. EMA WS/1344 (2019-01-31): DKA 9.87/7.58/4.40 per 100 PY, 'No new non-clinical data'. Contra 2018 holds.

PMID 30710078, epub 2019-02-01, open access; quote verbatim, and 'concerns have been raised about their potential to induce euglycemic ketoacidosis' verbatim, so retrodiction stands. Own track and partial call agreed. subjects 'patients' on a rat-only paper is a harmless oddity.

PMID 22402735, epub 2012-03-08; quote verbatim (abstract). Word-bounded grep of 202293 PharmR: zero diet-induced/DIO/obese/ketone/hydroxybutyrate hits, so model_filed false holds. Own track under decision 8; opener untested agreed.

PMID 30026335, epub 2018-07-19; quote verbatim (abstract). Henry 2015 abstract: no DKA, no ketone level (full text Cloudflare-blocked); DEPICT-1 24-wk 1/2/1 ambiguous, so 2018 holds. Drafter's pairing, direction only; rests on rule question 3.

Quote verbatim at sources/206111/206111Orig1s000PharmR.txt lines 556-557; GLP Study# RS618 (line 294), 28-day empagliflozin 3 mg/kg with or without metformin 300 mg/kg, male ZDF; no study date in the review, signed 2015-04-15. Low confidence per #36/#38; opener agreed.

PMID 30287422, quote verbatim (abstract). The null is an incidental tox-study line in obese insulin-resistant rats whose plasma insulin rose 65% on empagliflozin (review lines 548-561); insulinopenic ketogenesis was never tested and the null never framed as a prediction: untested with note.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 (#35, #87, #58): incidental ketone null in a hyperinsulinaemic T2D rat; insulin-deficient DKA never tested, no source links the null to T1D DKA, and the T1D class never relied on the ZDF rat (#72 absent).

entries.note: PMID 31858718, epub 2020-01-21, OA full text (PMC7064984): EASE-3 'not used during model development', aim 'to confirm' the observed 2.5 mg result; retro under decision 10. Table 2: simulated -0.27/-0.29 vs -0.28, within_2x. Filing unstated; model_filed null holds.

missing: Devenny 2012 (https://doi.org/10.1038/oby.2012.59, PMID 22402735, epub 2012-03-08): dapagliflozin raised fasting beta-hydroxybutyrate in diet-induced obese rats, a member-drug rodent model that showed the ketone signal before any T1D trial; the draft sets it aside in judgement. No source compares it with patients, so a candidate track only (rule question 3).

Vallon 2013 (https://doi.org/10.1152/ajprenal.00409.2012, PMID 23152292, epub 2012-11-14): Sglt2 knockout in Akita mice prevented glomerular hyperfiltration, the same system and prediction as the akita-mouse track one year earlier by genetic deletion; model_first_use_year 2013 should be 2012 (no status change).

Tahara 2014 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jphp.12223, PMID 24533859, epub 2014-02-17): ipragliflozin in STZ type 1 diabetic rats, the third member on the stz-rat track; same system, no status change, worth citing against Kaku 2019.

EMA variation assessment report WS/1344 (EMA/CHMP/213138/2019, 31 January 2019, https://www.ema.europa.eu/documents/variation-report/edistride-h-c-4161-ws-1344-epar-assessment-report-variation_en.pdf): tier-2 record of the dapagliflozin T1D DKA (9.87/7.58/4.40 per 100 patient-years for 5 mg/10 mg/placebo, long-term pool), 'No new non-clinical data have been submitted in this application', only the 5 mg dose recommended, and a post-authorisation 'Nonclinical mechanistic model studies ... Ketoacidosis' commitment. The draft says it was not obtained; it changes no status.

FDA EMDAC briefing document, 13 November 2019 (empagliflozin 2.5 mg, T1D, 14-2 vote): not retrieved (fda.gov/media/132422 returns 404); unverified, tier 2 if found; the draft cites the vote from press coverage only.

Perkins 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1111/dom.13945, PMC7064984, open access) also carries a beta-hydroxybutyrate exposure-response Emax model built on EASE-3 and qualified by predicting the EASE-2 BHB changes ('minor blood BHB level elevation ... was confirmed'): a safety-cell retrodiction on the empa-t1d-exposure-response-sim track, not drafted. rule_questions: Dose cell when the filed model gave only an mg/kg dose-response, stated no exposure, occupancy or regimen target, and the dose inherited from T2D worked: is that `untested` (no prediction to test) or `same` under the table row 'reached, drug worked'? The v3 table has no row for a model that set no target.

Prospective versus retrodiction when the model paper's online date precedes the trial paper's online date by 30 days but the trial finished 15 months earlier (Vallon 2014 epub 2013-11-13; Cherney 2014 epub 2013-12-13, NCT01392560 completed 2012-08): does 'the clinic already knew' run from trial completion, meeting presentation, or publication?

A member-drug model in a different physiological state (insulin-replete DIO rat, Devenny 2012) that showed the harm the filed insulin-deficient model missed: is it its own safety track (`same`, direction only) or set aside as a different system, as the draft did?

A regulator-imposed dose restriction on safety grounds with no model margin (EMA kept dapagliflozin 5 mg only; FDA rejected empagliflozin 2.5 mg): confirm decision 16 leaves dose `untested` and scores the harm once in safety, rather than `contra` with blocked_by toxicity.

A stated null in a filed model whose physiology precludes the harm (NDA 206111 ZDF rat: hyperinsulinaemic, plasma insulin rose on empagliflozin, 'ketone bodies were unremarkable') set against T1D DKA: `contra` as a failed stated prediction (decision 4 safety row) or `untested` as a condition the model never tested (#35/#72, #87)? #58 settles null-null but not null-in-model/harm-in-patients.
